source_text: Gishiri cutting, a procedure entailing incision into the anterior vaginal wall, is strongly associated with the development of vesico-vaginal fistulae (VVF), a chronic condition characterized by an abnormal opening between the bladder and vagina that results in continuous involuntary urinary leakage. [24]
